table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AccountName=name1, 
	Category,
	Debit= CASE WHEN value1 > 0 THEN Value1 ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE WHEN value1 < 0 THEN ABS(Value1) ELSE 0 END,
	AliasName
FROM
	(SELECT A.Name AS name1, 
		Sum(Debit - Credit) AS value1, 
		A.AliasName,
		Category=SC.Name
	FROM	VirtualGL V,
		Accounts A,
		SubAccounts S, 
		Supplier Sp,
		SupplierCategory SC
	WHERE 	V.Date <= :ar_date AND 
		(A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OR
		A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AND
		V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND 
		A.AccCode = Sp.SuppCode AND
		Sp.SuppCatCode = SC.SuppCatCode AND
		SC.SuppCatCode IN (:ar_SuppCat) AND
		A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND 
		S.SubAccCode = 7
	GROUP BY A.AccCode, A.Name, A.AliasName, SC.Name) A
ORDER BY Category, AccountName, A.AliasName
